# Business Model Risk Desk

> We do not say if you should exist. We say where this internet/app model breaks, and the plan to fix those breaks.

Public site. No auth. Assessments of live URLs are not available yet.

## Pages

- [Home](/): wordmark, promise, URL field (disabled; assessments next).
- [Method](/method): glance object (`dominant_break`, `time_to_break`, `evidence`, `model_condition`).
- [Sample anatomy](/sample): how to read the frozen sample.
- [Sample report (HTML)](/r/sample): frozen labeled-fiction assessment of Porchlist, a fake local-services marketplace. Dominant break is payment-company approval to sit in the money (inferred). Charging the homeowner is merchant of record. Also: vetting before payout, off-platform repeat work, PSP underwrite tripwires, legal tripwires.
- [Sample report (Markdown)](/r/sample.md): the same data as markdown.

The glance object is four fields: dominant_break, time_to_break (already | this_cycle | later | unbounded_if_holds), evidence (measured | inferred | unknown), model_condition (breaking | fragile | contingent | insufficient_evidence).
